_comment: Hand-written raw-spec.json, used by checks.resolve-lazy-self's pin step (#49). lazy.nvim with
`pin = true`, so a 2-pass resolve (plain, then with --lock) can prove the freeze actually
reaches the lazyNvim slot the same way it reaches an ordinary plugin's entry.
`build = false` is lazy's own "do not build" (extract.lua dumps it as the literal `false`),
and must produce *no* warning at all -- unlike raw-spec-tag.json's `:TSUpdate`, which must
produce exactly one. Without this fixture, an implementation that warns on `p.build ~= nil`
instead of `classify_build(p.build).kind ~= "none"` would still pass every other check: no
other fixture in this directory gives lazy.nvim a literal `build = false`.
